## n8n automations
- CS Live Inbox: Gmail and OpenAI workflow that triages support emails and saves AI-drafted replies as Gmail drafts for a person to review. https://omharregidor.vercel.app/automations/cs-live-inbox
- Daily Sales Pulse: scheduled workflow that pulls Shopify orders, calculates totals in code and posts an AI-written summary to Slack. https://omharregidor.vercel.app/automations/daily-sales-pulse
- SOP Assistant: AI agent that answers staff questions about company procedures in Slack or a chat window. https://omharregidor.vercel.app/automations/sop-assistant
